request_scope: each measured stream is enclosed by an ROCTx range after two warmups; initialization and teardown are excluded
device_view: request wall = union(kernel and memory-copy intervals) + all remaining request time
host_view: request wall = union(HIP API intervals) + all remaining non-HIP application time
reconciliation_gate: device and host decompositions each sum to request wall within 1 ms or 0.5%, whichever is larger; critical-path buckets are mutually exclusive and sum exactly after timestamp clipping
replication_gate: three profiled measured requests per condition and target; report every request plus median, never treat profiler wall time as production latency
sensor_metadata: record AMD SMI clocks, temperature, power, and utilization immediately before and after each capture when available
correctness_gate: exact hyp_text and token_ids_csv match the promoted EXP-0003 result within each target and graph condition
decision_rule: select an optimization lead only if one stable bucket explains at least 50% of the reconciled cross-target non-GPU gap; otherwise HOLD and add finer instrumentation
